dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How come you can't go back?

dialogues.speaker: Yangzhen
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't usually talk about this, but I'm a tea merchant from Liyue. Most of my business runs by sea.

dialogues.speaker: Yangzhen
dialogues.text: Who could've guessed? A while back, I got caught in a storm at sea and lost most of my cargo... By the time I reached Dornman Port, I couldn't even cover my costs.

dialogues.speaker: Yangzhen
dialogues.text: I couldn't bring myself to go home like that. So, I stayed on and tried to start a different business in these parts. I figured that I'd at least earn back what I lost. It's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Yangzhen
dialogues.text: But enough of that. It's just useless grumbling. I guess I'm really just hungry for Grilled Tiger Fish. I'm sorry you had to hear all that nonsense.
